steps.title: Big land
steps.body: A map can hold a million bricks. The Map tab’s Big worlds section shows how big this map is and makes big land to try it on: rolling grass and hills of bricks, with a flat clearing in the middle where the player starts.
steps.task: On the Map tab, under Big worlds, pick 512 × 512 studs and press Make.

how.text: Click “Scene” in the workspace tabs at the top.
On the right, click the Map tab and scroll down to Big worlds.
Under “New big land”, pick 512 × 512 studs and press Make. A new map of about 58,000 bricks opens.

steps.title: How far you see
steps.body: A big map is not drawn whole. The view loads the chunks (32 × 32 studs each) around where you look, the nearest first, and the fog closes in where they end. “How far you see” sets that distance: further shows more but costs more to draw. The counter at the top of the view shows how many chunks are loaded.
steps.task: Drag “How far you see” to 384 studs.

how.text: Under Big worlds, drag “How far you see” to 384. The view loads more chunks around the centre.

steps.title: Start here
steps.body: Play starts the game on the start map. Make this big land the start map, so ▶ Play opens it.
steps.task: Make this map the start map.

how.text: Set the start map to this map (Project tab › Start map; the helper does it in one step).

steps.title: Play a big map
steps.body: In the game a big map plays the area around the hero: the bricks there are solid and the neighbours there walk about; further away they sleep until the hero comes near. Chunks stream in as the hero moves.

how.text: Press ▶ Play at the top (or F5).

steps.title: The world follows you
steps.body: Walk out of the clearing into the hills. The solid area moves with the hero and new chunks appear ahead of you; the minimap shows the area around you.
steps.task: Walk at least 60 studs from where you started (hold W; Shift runs).

how.text: Hold W to walk (Shift to run) until you are out among the hills. The helper takes the hero there.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You made a big land, chose how far you see and played it while the world followed the hero. A map holds up to 1,000,000 bricks; 2048 × 2048 studs of land is about 950,000. Press Esc or Stop to leave Play.
